rationale_summary: The document primarily frames algorithm recommendation governance as necessary to maintain social order and uphold 'socialist core values,' prevent disruption to economic and social order, and suppress harmful information. The recurring emphasis on 'social public interest,' 'social mobilization capability,' 'public opinion attributes,' and preventing content that disturbs social order places social stability as the dominant frame. Secondary frames include fundamental rights (user transparency, opt-out rights, protections for minors, elderly, and workers), consumer/public safety (fraud prevention, minor protection, anti-addiction), and national security (explicit mention of national security protection).

evidence_spans.quote: 弘扬社会主义核心价值观，维护国家安全和社会公共利益
